# hostname-lint exemptions — exact stripped line text, not line numbers (see
# .github/hostname_lint.py's docstring for why: this self-invalidates the moment
# the surrounding prose changes, instead of silently exempting whatever line a
# stale number happens to point at).
#
# Two kinds of legitimate hit:
#  (a) historical record — a dated checklist/changelog entry documenting what was
#      actually verified against the OLD host at the time; rewriting it would
#      misrepresent history.
#  (b) intentional dual-domain support — verify.actionstate.ai is still LIVE
#      (dual Cloud Run domain mapping alongside verify.agentactioncapsule.org, same
#      pattern as witness/anchor), so code and tests that deliberately keep
#      recognizing it are correct, not drift.
